clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Arcane Feedback prepares priests to face hostile spellcasters. High Priestess Laurena teaches the rite in the Cathedral of Light, where faith is shaped into a defense against arcane power.

At the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena warns acolytes that arcane magic remains a danger. The Holy Light brings healing, warmth, and divine order, while raw magic can turn volatile and lead to corruption or catastrophe. Warlocks, renegade sorcerers, and magical beasts threaten the faithful. Priests learn that faith can become an active ward against spells around them.

Arcane Feedback turns a hostile spellcaster's power back against them. The ward does more than deflect spells: it burns through the caster's mana and causes agony. Laurena teaches the rite to human priests preparing to travel beyond Stormwind, so the Cathedral's emissaries can face sorcery with a defense of their own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
I would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.
